title: TwelveSpec industry intelligence supplement
scope: Public industry research and original software application decisions; no private attachment contents are embedded.

sources.name: PPAI industry association
sources.publicObservation: PPAI connects promotional-product distributors, suppliers and service providers through research, education and industry programs.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Use an industry knowledge register and partner qualification; membership alone never sets route readiness.

sources.name: PPAI 2025 US distributor sales estimate
sources.publicObservation: The January 12, 2026 public summary estimates 2025 US distributor sales at $27.1 billion, up 1.3%; the full report is restricted to professional members.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Track landed cost, quote expiry and actual direct profit. This market estimate is neither TwelveSpec revenue nor an addressable-market forecast.

sources.name: PPAI 2026 trends analysis
sources.publicObservation: PPAI discusses margin pressure, tariff uncertainty and operational efficiency in its 2026 outlook.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Version freight/duty assumptions, reprice expired offers and measure quote handling and exception work.

sources.name: PPAI sustainability and responsibility resources
sources.publicObservation: PPAI provides responsible-sourcing and sustainability resources, including attention to packaging obligations.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Store claim evidence, responsible party, applicable market and expiry; avoid an unsupported eco-ready badge.

sources.name: PRINTING United Alliance
sources.publicObservation: PRINTING United Alliance covers printing markets through education, technical resources, research and certification programs.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Train role-specific operators across print, apparel, packaging and wide format; keep the application multi-family.

sources.name: PRINTING United industry benchmarking
sources.edition: 2026 report index; full reports not accessed
sources.publicObservation: Its report index spans commercial print, wide format, print buyers and decorated apparel; full report access is membership/purchase dependent.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Maintain separate segment, period, sample and currency metadata. Do not add overlapping market studies together.

sources.name: PRINTING United G7+ certification families
sources.publicObservation: G7+ distinguishes expert, facility and system certification, each with its own requirements.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Record credential scope, holder, version and validity; artwork upload cannot confer certification.

sources.name: G7+ System Certification
sources.publicObservation: System certification evaluates print calibration capability and is specific to the evaluated system/version.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: A PDF, ICC tag or generated preview is not a certified printing system. Capture actual qualification evidence.

sources.name: ISA sign permitting resources
sources.publicObservation: ISA describes permitting as part of sign projects and provides resources for local sign-code issues.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Add project destination, installation scope, permit/engineering responsibility and approval status where applicable.

sources.name: TLMI technical, regulatory and sustainability committees
sources.publicObservation: TLMI addresses label/converting technical topics and regulatory issues such as EPR and recycling.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Treat facestock, adhesive, liner, roll orientation and application environment as explicit specification fields.

sources.name: FEFCO corrugated packaging code
sources.edition: 12th edition as presented on the official page
sources.publicObservation: The official page identifies a 12th-edition classification of corrugated box designs.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: A style code aids communication; exact dimensions, material and a producer-approved dieline still govern manufacturing.

sources.name: ISO processing steps for PDF
sources.edition: ISO 19593-1:2026, edition 2; full paid text not acquired
sources.publicObservation: ISO lists ISO 19593-1:2026, edition 2, published October 2026, with the 2018 edition withdrawn.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Version finishing-layer semantics and target export profiles; the public abstract does not establish implementation conformance.

sources.name: ICC profile specifications
sources.edition: ICC.1:2022; April 2025 amendment noted on the page
sources.publicObservation: ICC identifies ICC.1:2022/profile version 4.4 and describes ICC and iccMAX as distinct specifications.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Record source/output profiles, intent and hashes per producer profile; do not infer a universal CMYK destination.

sources.name: Ghent Workgroup packaging
sources.publicObservation: GWG distinguishes printable PDF content from packaging production information and develops processing-step test suites.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Preserve cut, crease, varnish, white and other semantic roles separately from customer print art.

sources.name: GWG processing-step specifications/test resources
sources.publicObservation: The requested resource redirects to a login page.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Keep exact profile/test-suite conformance unverified until authorized materials and fixtures are available.

sources.name: W3C SVG coordinate systems
sources.edition: SVG 2 coordinate-system chapter; current TR page
sources.publicObservation: SVG viewports, viewBox coordinates, transforms and physical units have distinct meanings.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Use explicit mm-space and pixel transforms; CSS pixels and a viewBox are not independent manufacturing dimensions.

sources.name: GS1 size/color variation guidance
sources.publicObservation: GS1 identifies size/color combinations as distinct product variations for GTIN assignment.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Retain exact source-part/variant identity and validate supplied GTINs; never generate a manufacturer GTIN from a title.

sources.name: GS1 system architecture
sources.publicObservation: The published architecture distinguishes identification, capture, sharing and data use.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Separate canonical identity, external identifiers, master/source facts and transaction/visibility events.

sources.name: IPTC photo metadata
sources.publicObservation: The pinned metadata specification includes creator, credit, rights usage and accessibility fields.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Carry rights/attribution and accessibility through allowed public derivatives; redact private routing and personal details.

sources.name: CIP4 JDF and XJDF
sources.publicObservation: CIP4 maintains JDF/JMF and XJDF/XJMF for exchanging production information.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Keep a shared internal job contract and add an adapter only for a real partner requirement; no machine actuation is enabled.

sources.name: CIP4 Conventional Printing ICS
sources.publicObservation: CIP4 announced XJDF Conventional Printing ICS 2.2 on April 27, 2026, scoped to specific workflow roles.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Pin the exact role/profile when integrating a partner; a generic XML export does not prove interoperability.

sources.name: Illustrator saved document presets
sources.publicObservation: Adobe documents saved New Document presets with artboard, units, bleed, color mode and raster-effect settings.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Distinguish a reusable document preset, a native editable template and a producer-approved imprint specification.

sources.name: Illustrator native-template reference URL
sources.publicObservation: This supplied URL was not accessible through the research tool.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Native AI/AIT editing and Saved-tab behavior require licensed desktop verification; no native success is inferred.

sources.name: Canva upload formats and requirements
sources.publicObservation: Canva documents format-specific constraints and warns that imported Illustrator layers may flatten.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Treat imported imagery, editable objects and native frames as separate capability tests; preserve originals and report fidelity loss.

sources.name: Epilog raster versus vector engraving
sources.edition: Supplied /staging/ URL redirects to this canonical path
sources.publicObservation: Epilog distinguishes raster and vector artwork behavior for engraving.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Keep raster engraving, vector engraving and cutting roles separate; material/fixture/machine settings are provider controlled.

sources.name: Roland VersaWorks special ink aliases
sources.publicObservation: VersaWorks maps spot-name aliases to particular special-ink channels.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Use provider/device export mappings for white, gloss, metallic and primer rather than hardcoded global spot names.

sources.name: Yoycol print specifications hub
sources.publicObservation: The hub gives different requirements for DTG, DTF, AOP, sublimation and embroidery and directs users to exact product templates.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Do not universalize one supplier’s resolution, color mode, maximum area, MOQ or lead time.

sources.name: CPSC promotional-product responsibility FAQ
sources.publicObservation: Official indexed text makes responsibility dependent on the arrangements for decorating, producing and selling a finished children’s product.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Record responsible parties and applicability decisions instead of assuming a supplier owns every obligation.

sources.name: CPSC children’s product certificates
sources.publicObservation: CPSC distinguishes applicable children’s-product rules, responsible manufacturers/importers, test evidence and certificates; the page notes 2026 eFiling changes.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Track intended use/age, jurisdiction, responsible party, batch/lot, applicable tests and evidence. Qualified review determines the particular obligation.

sources.name: USPS mailpiece design resources
sources.publicObservation: USPS points to the DMM for official domestic mailing standards and QSGs for summaries.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Direct-mail configuration needs mail class, dimensions/weight, addressing, preparation and mailing-partner acceptance, not just print bleed.

sources.name: FTC Green Guides summary
sources.publicObservation: FTC guidance calls for support and qualification of environmental marketing claims.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Require substantiation, claim wording, scope and review before publishing sustainability assertions; a recycled tag is insufficient.

sources.name: GS1 product image specification reference
sources.publicObservation: Direct access to the supplied PDF returned 403.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Keep detailed image-standard conformance unverified; do not fabricate naming or image-angle requirements.

sources.name: Quality Logo Products imprint education
sources.publicObservation: This educational article discusses how substrate and decoration method affect an imprint.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Useful buyer education; broad comparisons and included-color examples are not universal pricing or engineering rules.

sources.name: PromoStandards protocol families
sources.publicObservation: PromoStandards publishes separate data, status and transaction protocol families.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Verify each direct supplier service/version independently. Retain the explicit prohibition on PSRESTful.

sources.name: GWG user-guide reference URL
sources.publicObservation: The research tool could not retrieve this resource within its content limit.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Mark detailed guide contents unreviewed; rely on accessible public summaries without claiming full conformance.

sources.name: PDF Association ISO status register
sources.publicObservation: PDF Association publishes a status register for ISO work relating to PDF.
sources.twelveSpecApplication: Use standards version/status metadata and verify the normative publisher before selecting an output contract.

domains.name: Promotional hardgoods
domains.twelveSpecWorkflow: Canonical product → configured source option → complete landed quote → art/proof review → approved supplier requirement → shipment/reorder.

domains.name: Decorated apparel and headwear
domains.twelveSpecWorkflow: Size grid → exact variant → shared logo project → method-specific review → blank supply/decoration/QC → wearer or company delivery.

domains.name: School, team and fundraiser programs
domains.twelveSpecWorkflow: Program membership → assigned catalog/brand → selection → close/minimum review → approved batch → distribution; retain allocation references.

domains.name: POD and small-run merchandise
requiredInputs: provider variant and print file contract
domains.twelveSpecWorkflow: Validated configuration → customer agreement/payment gate → approved provider draft/confirmation → event reconciliation → packages/claims.

domains.name: Commercial flat print, publications and stationery
domains.twelveSpecWorkflow: Product family specification → original artwork → registered proof/preflight → frozen manufacturing specification → print/finish/QC/dispatch.

domains.name: Direct mail and variable-data print
domains.twelveSpecWorkflow: Print specification + authorized variable data → merge/sample review → postal preparation acceptance → mailing evidence and cost references.

domains.name: Signs, wide format and applied graphics
domains.twelveSpecWorkflow: Project/site intake → supplier-specific media and artwork rules → panel/finish review → print/cut → installation or shipping handoff.

domains.name: Exhibitions, displays, tents and event kits
domains.twelveSpecWorkflow: Campaign project → exact component/panel specs → coordinated art → multi-source agreement/jobs → consolidated or approved split delivery.
exceptionConditions: generic tent image used as dieline

domains.name: Labels, stickers and converting
domains.twelveSpecWorkflow: Application-specific configuration → registered print/cut/finish roles → producer preflight → print/conversion/QC → traceable batch.

domains.name: Packaging, corrugated and folding cartons
domains.twelveSpecWorkflow: Packaging brief → producer source/dieline → panel-aware artwork → finish/preflight → print/conversion/assembly → shipment/QC.
exceptionConditions: style code mistaken for exact tooling

domains.name: Awards, drinkware, gifts and engraving
domains.twelveSpecWorkflow: Exact blank → permitted decoration option → customer visual approval → specialist route evidence → QC and protected shipment.

domains.name: Industrial, safety and custom-engineered sourcing
domains.twelveSpecWorkflow: Assisted technical RFQ → source/engineering review → documented quote and approvals → specialist production handoff → inspection/reconciliation.

domains.name: B2B company stores, redemption and recurring programs
domains.twelveSpecWorkflow: Program eligibility → configured catalog → atomic commitment/approval → order/jobs → delivery → reconciled usage → repeat/reorder.

domains.name: Bundles, kitting, warehousing and fulfillment
domains.twelveSpecWorkflow: Frozen kit agreement → component purchase requirements → receipts → assembly/QC → exact package allocations → actual cost closeout.
exceptionConditions: freight counted once for multiple legs

domains.name: Design, prepress, proof and media interchange
domains.twelveSpecWorkflow: Shared original → editable design → illustrative preview → independent proof decision and technical checks → approved derivative/route handoff.

domains.name: Distributor operations, economics and owner workload
domains.twelveSpecWorkflow: Assigned inquiry → bounded staff decisions → governed exceptions → reliable event-driven follow-through → reconciled profit and workload metrics.

decisions.title: One canonical catalog and source-offer boundary
decisions.implementation: Retain existing canonical identity and private source records; creative references enter a review queue and never become a second PIM.

decisions.title: Separate creative canvas from verified imprint geometry
decisions.implementation: Preflight now labels manufacturing requirements unverified. A versioned, exact provider geometry/profile resolver is still open.

decisions.title: No universal DPI, bleed or color defaults
decisions.implementation: Remove generic manufacturing thresholds from preliminary preflight; measure pixels/physical placement and retain null requirements.

decisions.title: Independent readiness for each intended use
decisions.implementation: Creative draft, preview, marketing, quote, proof, production and provider acceptance have separate evidence requirements.

decisions.title: Provider-specific process and layer semantics
decisions.implementation: Keep print, white/primer/varnish, foil, cut/crease and nonprinting guide roles separate; map target names in reviewed output profiles.

decisions.title: One original artwork and immutable lineage
decisions.implementation: Retain originals, content hashes and exact configuration; extend safe edit/export fidelity rather than creating a separate editor.

decisions.title: Artwork interoperability is destination-specific
decisions.implementation: Treat PNG/SVG/PDF interchange and native AI/AIT/Canva features as separate tests with explicit loss reports.

decisions.title: Batch and compliance evidence follows the finished product
decisions.implementation: Track intended use, responsible party, applicable jurisdiction and evidence; never infer all liability or certification from a supplier name.

decisions.title: Claims and rights need field-level authority
decisions.implementation: Publish only allowed media and substantiated product/environmental claims, retaining effective dates and revocation history.

decisions.title: Program and kit identity survives commerce
decisions.implementation: Continue the actual cart/quote/order context repair; do not add an independent budget or bundle subsystem.

decisions.title: Partner handoff includes uncertainty and acceptance
decisions.implementation: Approved payload, transfer and acknowledgment are separate; reconcile ambiguous outcomes before repeating a write.

decisions.title: Full versus partial feeds are explicit
decisions.implementation: A missing row in a partial feed does not mean discontinued; snapshot scope, cursors and failure checkpoints survive replay.

decisions.title: Direct native integrations and licensed discovery
decisions.implementation: Use direct reviewed supplier profiles and authorized ASI interfaces. PSRESTful remains prohibited.

decisions.title: Operational reporting measures owner workload
decisions.implementation: Measure touches, active minutes, waiting causes and direct profit per owner hour; no invented savings or readiness percentage.

decisions.title: Advanced engines remain reserved
decisions.implementation: AI design, automatic digitization, validated 3D, CAD, GL/payroll, enterprise MRP and autonomous purchasing stay Coming Soon.

decisions.title: Standards and research have scoped versions
decisions.implementation: Maintain exact publisher, edition, access level, scope and review date; a standard abstract or association logo does not certify an output.

limitations: Broad relevant value-chain coverage, not an exhaustive survey of every geography or product regulation.
Public summaries and restricted/unavailable resources are labeled separately.
No authenticated supplier, legal certification, paid report or manufacturing route is verified by research.
Existing architecture and original 20-module/95-scenario acceptance remain controlling.
